## Complexity Scoring Legend
The **Complexity Score** (0-10 scale) is calculated from 10 structural signals:
- Authentication requirements, endpoint count, schema depth, response size
- Error surface, error codes count, pagination support & pattern
- Parameter complexity, rate limiting complexity
- Adjusted by documentation quality (high docs reduce score, low docs increase it)

**Buckets:**
- **Simple:** 0.0-2.5 — Minimal complexity, few parameters, simple responses
- **Moderate:** 2.6-5.0 — Standard REST APIs with moderate features
- **Complex:** 5.1-7.5 — Many endpoints, deep schemas, or complex patterns
- **Very complex:** 7.6-10.0 — Highly sophisticated APIs with many advanced features
